notes.title: Reel Big Final Game Update!
notes.content:
Have you been staying up night after night wondering... will the Super Collection get another game? How many games do you think it'll have? The answer is yes and 10. A nice round number and it's one of the games I always wanted to make.

[previewyoutube=EU3SNAugy6o;full][/previewyoutube]
When I was younger, there was a site my friends and I played games at and there were a few games that left lasting impressions with me but one that I always remembered fondly was Fishy. Fishy was a simple game where you strive to be the biggest fish in the pond and ultimately destroy an ecosystem with gluttony. I always knew I wanted to make this game with the OHR.RPG.CE. During the 4th quarter of 2024 I decided to go for it! That game would become Big Fish.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41321432/597b0a4729d02ed647a9ac424b32a48238aebd72.gif[/img]

What's different between Big Fish and Fishy you might ask? Well... I stopped to figure out what I didn't like about Fishy and corrected it for my own. There's fish variety, different backgrounds, and the biggest thing I think is that instead of dying in one hit you now get three hits before you die. Fishy was also a game about wrecking a pond's ecosystem and in Big Fish the goal is to become big enough to eat the local shark, which is big enough to eat everything and does!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41321432/cad808be835f989b3a9b0ee9662254c1dcb78f51.gif[/img]

Thanks for your continued interest in the Super Collection and supporting Red Triangle Games. I hope these free games brighten your day even just a little bit. It's been a fun and rewarding journey having a project to try out experimental short games and remaster older games.

notes.title: Super Update to Fox in the Woods
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41321432/c2e1ab7e504c8484e70e8aa9bb4e5802e94fa9d4.gif[/img]
Remember Fox in the Woods? Of course you do! Now, two years later it's gotten the update it deserves with the addition of jumping. And you might be thinking... regular jumping? Pssh. I've waited two years for an update to this game. Nope. How about TWICE the jumping. That's right our furry friend the fox can do a double jump to make it easier to snag those leaves.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41321432/30871470c4f1ad82a8fbce472e369d5bd6e3c72b.gif[/img]
In addition to that, the game has been rebalanced a bit. Originally it kind of went on way too long when it's really only intended to be about a 2-3 minute game. The Let's Play recorded in 2022 was 10 minutes. So now the game is a bit more in line with what I originally wanted it to be in terms of scope and gameplay.

A lot of thought is going into what will be the tenth and final game in the Super Collection. With Takoyaki Surprise finished, it's time to do another small scale experimental game, much like Fox in the Woods. Hope you enjoy this cute update and enjoy your fall.

notes.title: Super Collection Super Update!
notes.content:
The Super Collection has been updated with a few new things since launch. Let's go through them all!

[previewyoutube=s_whiQbl6Ic;full][/previewyoutube]
First up Block Bonanza came out at the end of last year. It's a fun western themed match-three style puzzle game designed to be 1-bit. It has three worlds, boss battles and a decent variety of gameplay within the match format. Also a brilliant soundtrack by Eponym, who helped with Video Goose also in the collection.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41321432/96e314fbcb434ef5e93df3242d116c1df41ddde4.gif[/img]
The next new game added was Fox in the Woods. In an effort to learn new things about the OHR.RPG.Ce this game was created. It's a cute little game, very simple in concept where you collect leaves as a little fox to try and make your summer last a little bit longer.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41321432/9d19c7e40581d2c153c5f99a8eabe64ed22aa516.png[/img]
Next up, the full collection now supports achievements! Some are pretty challenging, some are pretty easy. Hopefully you can collect them all. As new games get added to the collection, more achievements will come as well. Three in particular are for Scare Spree, and earning them will be no easy feat as they are for beating the high scores that were set on the youtube videos.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41321432/fa2c99f2b673d023e5054f6a9350208a3d1d9e75.gif[/img]
Finally, let's look ahead slightly to next year with another update coming to the collection. This will be probably the longest and most full-length of a game that will be in it to date. It's a silly point and click action adventure game that was originally made in 2010 with Red Triangle Games and Soda Piggy. Normally Soda Piggy has done music or art, but in this instance he was the programmer. One of the things with bringing Takoyaki Surprise to life will be totally new art, an original soundtrack and some quality of life improvements, similar to what you might have experienced with Mr. Triangle's Maze.

Thanks for your interest in the Super Collection and supporting Red Triangle Games. We hope these free games brighten your day even just a little bit.
